static_traits.name: Wang Wei
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with colleagues, feeling isolated, reducing socializing with colleagues
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems before; has not received psychological counseling treatment before; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic, able to self-Reflect and gain insight; highly cooperative; emotions leaning Anxious but can be Guided

basic_info.main_problem: I feel colleagues are no longer willing to help me, they must think I am taking advantage of them, this makes me feel isolated and somewhat persecuted.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of isolation and persecution are affecting my mental health and work performance.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough, easily judged or rejected by others

special_situations.event: When asking a colleague in the office for help completing a report, was refused by the other on the grounds of 'being very busy'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If colleagues refuse to help, it means they think I am taking advantage of them and do not like me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces help-seeking, completes tasks alone to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They think I am using them

special_situations.event: After starting archery classes, time for after-work gatherings and interaction with colleagues decreased
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not spent time socializing with them, they will distance from me and negate me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding interacting with colleagues, trying not to make requests to lower the risk of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Because I do not accompany them, they have opinions about me

special_situations.event: Observed during office hours that colleagues have recently offered help less proactively
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' changes in behavior must be about me, and mean that I did something wrong
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessively monitors others' reactions, repeatedly speculating about others' thoughts
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are targeting me; I am being excluded

special_situations.event: When thinking of asking a colleague for help again, recalls the earlier experience of being refused
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If rejected again, it proves I have been taking advantage, and will be excluded by more people
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: No longer seeking help, lowering visibility for Self-protection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I ask again they will hate me even more

core_conflict.wish: Yearns to be accepted, supported, and recognized by colleagues
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged as 'taking advantage', Being rejected and excluded
defense_goal: By avoiding seeking help and reducing interaction to lower the risk of Being rejected
By guessing others' thoughts to gain a sense of control and preemptively Self-protect
Keeps low exposure to maintain fragile self-esteem and a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: not good enough, an outsider easily Being rejected
object_relations.object_representation: picky, others/colleagues who judge and are unwilling to help
object_relations.linking_affect: Anxiety, shame, feelings of isolation and being rejected

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor asks 'what evidence supports that colleagues think so' or clarifies the difference between feelings and facts
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Feeling oneself questioned, tending to project self-criticism onto others, believing others will negate oneself (transference: judgment cast onto the outside world)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: First Empathizing with her sense of being rejected and unease; tone gentle, Clarifying the difference between 'thoughts - evidence'; use open-ended Questioning and concretizing, Guiding her to identify verifiable information, avoiding confrontational correction.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to try communicating directly with colleagues and expressing her own needs and feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing potential rejection as a certain outcome, tending to use 'they are busy' as a reason for inaction
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Probing the needs behind her concerns with a supportive tone; using Role playing and small-step experiments, clarifying the minimum viable action, lowering the one-time communication threshold and Reinforcing self-efficacy.

manifestations: Feels isolated at work, with reduced social contact with colleagues
Avoids interaction and asking for help, finds it hard to talk to friends and family about distress
Excessive concern with others' evaluations, worries about group exclusion
outcomes: Decline in work performance, motivation and emotions affected
Shaken sense of self-worth and rising insecurity

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believing colleagues think one is taking advantage
Interpreting colleagues' 'being busy' as dissatisfaction with or negation of oneself

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: No longer asking colleagues for help, shouldering tasks alone
Not confiding distress to friends or family, processing emotions internally

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly concerned about others' views and evaluations, interprets others' behavior cautiously
Worries about being seen as 'taking advantage', thus limiting help-seeking and interaction

positive_force: Having self-Reflection and insight ability, able to identify 'evidence-lacking' thoughts
Willing to seek help and start counseling, with clear motivation
Open to alternative perspectives and open communication
Willing to try clarifying communication with colleagues
negative_force: Mind-reading and jumping-to-conclusions cognitive patterns Reinforced negative interpretations
High dependence on external recognition, easily affected by fluctuations in social participation
Avoids seeking help and reduces interaction, further increasing isolation
Unwilling to use the existing Social support system (friends and family)
Rising insecurity, prone to overgeneralizing individual events as evidence of relationship deterioration

target_behavior.behavior: At work, avoids asking colleagues for help and interacting
antecedent: When work hours require others' assistance with tasks
Against the background of reduced social time with colleagues after starting archery classes
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being judged as 'taking advantage' and Being rejected, based on insecurity and dependence on external approval
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential shame and rejection, lowering Anxiety and uncertainty in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased work efficiency, Sense of isolation and increased sense of exclusion, emotions and Impaired motivation

target_behavior.behavior: In colleagues' behaviors, mind-reading and negative interpretation, accompanied by Anxiety and paranoia
antecedent: Colleagues refusing help on grounds of being busy
Observes colleagues have proactively offered less support lately
target_behavior.core_reason: Insecurity about self-worth and the need to seek external validation, leading to negative attributions of ambiguous cues
target_behavior.function: Providing Interpretation for uncertain interpersonal cues to gain temporary control
target_behavior.consequence: Heightened Anxiety and paranoia, Interpersonal relationships further tense and avoidant
